description: Find candidate DataScoop datasets from keywords or a short task description, such as "Find care homes in Surrey" or "restaurant inspections Chicago". Candidates describe declared coverage, not verified matches for the requested location. Call get_dataset_schema, then query_dataset with explicit filters; example filters are illustrative and are not inferred from the request.

country.description: Optional ISO country code, e.g. GB or US

query.description: What the user is looking for, in plain words

name: search_datasets
title: Search datasets
